description.zh: 从安宁疗护角度帮你理解：姑息治疗到底做什么、疼痛和症状怎么控制、什么时候引入、怎么和家人沟通意愿。先说清一件事——姑息治疗不等于临终关怀，也不等于放弃抗肿瘤治疗。
description.en: Explains what palliative care actually does, how symptoms are controlled, when to involve it, and how to discuss wishes. It is not hospice and not giving up on treatment.

welcome_message.zh: 我是安宁疗护视角助手。先说清一件事：姑息治疗不等于临终关怀，也不等于放弃抗肿瘤治疗——它的目标是减轻痛苦、改善生活质量，可以和抗肿瘤治疗同时进行。我帮你理清疼痛控制、症状管理、意愿沟通这些具体问题，以及该问医生什么。
welcome_message.en: Palliative care is not hospice and not stopping cancer treatment. It relieves suffering alongside treatment. I help with symptom control and conversations about what matters to you.

description.en: Clarify what it is and is not

prompt.zh: 医生说建议看姑息治疗门诊，我一下子很慌。请帮我解释姑息治疗到底做什么、和临终关怀有什么区别、什么时候会引入。
prompt.en: My doctor suggested palliative care and it frightened me. Explain what it does and how it differs from hospice.

description.zh: 疼痛评估与止痛的常见顾虑
description.en: Pain assessment and common worries about analgesia

prompt.zh: 我一直在疼，但不敢多用止痛药，怕上瘾、怕以后没药可用。请帮我理清疼痛评估和止痛的常见顾虑，以及该问医生什么。
prompt.en: I am in pain but afraid of addiction and of running out of options. Help me separate the real concerns from the myths.

prompt.zh: 我想和家人谈谈如果病情变化我希望怎么被照顾，但不知道怎么开口。请帮我列一下可以谈的内容和开场方式。
prompt.en: I want to talk with my family about how I would like to be cared for, but do not know how to start.

prompt.zh: 除了疼痛，还有哪些症状是安宁疗护会重点处理的？我该怎么向医生描述我的症状？
prompt.en: Besides pain, which symptoms does palliative care focus on, and how should I describe mine?

zh: 每天「20:00」提醒我记录疼痛程度与缓解情况，便于就诊时描述
每周三「10:00」帮我回顾这一周的症状变化与用药情况
复诊前「09:00」整理我这次想和医生谈的意愿相关问题
en: Every day at 20:00, prompt me to log pain levels and relief for the next visit
Every Wednesday at 10:00, review this week's symptom changes and medication
Before visits at 09:00, collect the wishes-related questions I want to raise
